outcome: maternal levels of pregnancy-related plasma protein A (PAPP-A)
maternal levels of beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (b-hCG)
cohort: The study included 267 cases of singleton pregnancies who underwent first-trimester screening tests and delivered between January 2016 and January 2019 at the study hospital.
finding: PAPP-A and free b-hCG values were not significantly affected by fetal gender in the overall cohort, but free b-hCG MoM levels were significantly higher in fetal females compared to males in cases with ischemic placental diseases.
cross-section timing: First trimester (for biochemical markers); at birth (for neonatal gender and conditions)
